task.title: AFC-01 contained reads RED regressions
task.description: Create failing behavioral tests for authorized internal symlinks versus external symlink/owner-root escapes in MCP resource/list and harness wiki/skills read paths. Design a bounded safe race fixture and explicit unsupported-platform behavior for a future shared descriptor-read seam. Test only source files in containment ownership; no production edits. Race test verifies descriptor/identity protection or explicit capability refusal; no unsupported full TOCTOU claim.
constraints: Read /Users/Goodea/goodea/keryx/.metaproject/index.md first. Local tests-creator fully; testing context; graph/wiki before deep code.

Root owns MCP dispatch/redact-seam/security redaction and scan. You own resources/contained readers/skills paths tests only. Coordinate shared files explicitly before edits.
